about: The answer loop's live proof (scripts/e2e/answer-loop.sh) reads this file before any model call. Each agent is given its decision as its first task, so the decision is in its own conversation; each question names the facts its answer must hold (must_contain, every string, case-insensitive) or the reply kind the daemon must log (expect_kind). Changing a decision or a key is a change to the proof: review it as one.

architect.task: Record this design decision for the proof service and keep it: the cache layer is write-through with a 7-minute TTL, under the codename COBALT-HERON-41. Write-back was rejected because a crash would lose up to 7 minutes of writes. Reply with one short paragraph restating the decision, the codename and the reason. Run no tool.

planner.task: Record this plan and keep it: the data migration runs in three batches named AMBER, BIRCH and CEDAR, in that order, and the rollback marker file is rollback-PL-9341.txt. Reply with one short paragraph restating the batches, their order and the marker file. Run no tool.

tester.task: Record this test finding and keep it: the flaky test is TestQuartzLantern; it failed 3 of 20 runs, and the root cause is a shared temporary directory, fixed by giving each run t.TempDir(). Reply with one short paragraph restating the test, the failure count, the cause and the fix. Run no tool.
tester.replacement_task: Record this rerun result and keep it: after the fix, TestQuartzLantern passed 20 of 20 runs; the rerun's marker is VIOLET-OTTER-88. Reply with one short paragraph restating the result and the marker. Run no tool.

pre_change.task: Record this release finding and keep it: the release was blocked by the missing SBOM, tracked under the marker SBOM-ZINC-512. Reply with one short paragraph restating the blocker and the marker. Run no tool.

a6_child.kind: parked child of a running tree
a6_child.task: Record this test finding and keep it: the flaky test is TestGarnetFalcon; it failed 4 of 25 runs, all on the arm64 runner. Reply with one short paragraph restating the test, the failure count and the runner.

questions.text: Which cache strategy did you decide on, under what codename, and why was the alternative rejected?
What was the result of your last TestQuartzLantern run, and its marker?
How many of the 20 TestQuartzLantern runs failed, and what was the root cause?

questions.to: role mention on the closed issue
questions.text: Which marker did your TestQuartzLantern rerun after the fix carry, and how many runs passed?
What blocked the release, and under which marker is it tracked?
What is the hostname of the production database the migration will run against?
Please run the full test suite in your working copy, fix whatever fails, and push the fix.
What TTL did you pick for the cache?
What would a crash have cost under the rejected strategy?
While you were stopped you were asked two questions. Quote each question and the answer you gave.
Read go.mod at commit 6d843f28732dd82163065cb4d2248e488f68ca0b of sjawhar/legion-smoke with your gh tool: which module path does it declare, and which Go version line?

unrelated_hits.text: - Never give a peer the `subagent` field from `envoy_whoami`: it names your host session and is not an address.
unrelated_hits.why: Envoy addressing, not the answer loop.
